name: Captain Fantastic and the Brown Dirt Cowboy

info.desc: Captain Fantastic and the Brown Dirt Cowboy, the ninth formal studio album release for Elton John, is an autobiographical account of the early musical careers of Elton John (Captain Fantastic) and Bernie Taupin (the Brown Dirt Cowboy). It was released in May 1975 by MCA in America and DJM in the UK. It debuted at number 1 on the US Billboard 200, the first album to do so, and stayed top for seven weeks. It was certified gold in May 1975 and was certified platinum and 3x platinum in March 1993 by the RIAA. In Canada, it also debuted at .

podcast.body: This album was cited as one that might have won Album of the Year in 1976 if Paul Simon had not received a repeat Grammy for his work (after previously winning with Simon and Garfunkel). "Might have made room for Elton John's album, Captain Fantastic and the Brown Dirt Cowboy to take the prize."
